verifications.claim: Samsung is discontinuing its native Samsung Messages app by July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Samsung Messages application will be discontinued in July 2026." (R1); "The Samsung Messages application will be discontinued in July 2026" (R2); similar direct statements in R3, R4, R5, R6, R8
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the discontinuation date as July 2026.

verifications.claim: Samsung is shifting entirely to Google Messages as the default RCS messaging platform on Galaxy devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "switching to Google Messages to continue using the messaging service on your Galaxy smartphone" (R1); "Upgrade to Google Messages as your default messaging app today" (R2); "switch to Google Messages as the default messaging app" (R3); pre-installed as default on recent models (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Samsung is making Google Messages the default, phasing out Samsung Messages, with RCS as key feature.

verifications.claim: Older phones (Android 11 or earlier) are unaffected.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Samsung messaging app will continue to function on devices running Android 11 or lower" (R1); "older Android OS (Android 11 or lower) are not affected" (R2); "devices running Android 11 and older will not be affected" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported across multiple sources specifying Android 11 or lower unaffected.

verifications.claim: Newer Galaxy devices (S26 and later) will not support the Samsung Messages app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "latest S-line smartphone users to download the Samsung Messages app from the Galaxy Store" (R1); "Galaxy S26 series and beyond, will not be able to download Samsung Messages" (R5); "Galaxy S26 and newer devices already do not allow Samsung Messages downloads" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state S26 and newer cannot download/install Samsung Messages.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will stop functioning for most users, including receiving/sending texts, by July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the app will stop working in your region" (R1 cited snippet); "you won’t be able to send any messages via Samsung’s app, except for emergency" (R2); "users will not be able to send messages with the app except for emergency services" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm app stops regular send/receive functions post-July 2026, except emergencies.

verifications.claim: Samsung is partnering with Google for a more consistent RCS (Rich Communication Services) experience.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "adopting Google's messaging solution. The short answer to this is RCS support... Google's messaging app offers all RCS features regardless of your carrier. The Samsung messaging app... depends on your mobile network" (R1); RCS as upgrade in R3, R4, R6
verifications.reasoning: Sources explain shift to Google Messages for better RCS consistency, but do not use 'partnering'; broader adoption described.

verifications.claim: Tizen OS-based smartwatches (older than Galaxy Watch4) will lose full message conversation history when this change occurs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "owners of Samsung smartwatches running Tizen OS... no longer be able to view full message conversation history... before the Galaxy Watch4" (R3, R5); "Smartwatches running Tizen OS (launched before Galaxy Watch4) will not support full message sync" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches sources specifying Tizen OS watches pre-Watch4 lose full history.

verifications.claim: Users who prefer Samsung Messages will lose features like custom chat rooms.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "losing Samsung Messages’ unique customization and UI integration" (R4); "lose out on some of the Samsung Messages customization options" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention loss of Samsung-specific customization, but no specific mention of 'custom chat rooms'; claim's example is broader/less precise.

verifications.claim: Google Messages brings new features like AI-powered spam detection and Gemini-based interactions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "AI-powered scam detection, spam filters... Gemini-based tools for smart replies" (R3, R5); "Gemini icon... to use Google Gemini AI chat options" (R7); "AI-based spam detection... Gemini-based AI features" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Directly lists AI spam/scam detection and Gemini features as Google Messages advantages.
